notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Proud Pack-Rhino and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Proud Pack-Rhino and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Bloom Hulk triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Proud Pack-Rhino trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Proud Pack-Rhino and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
